regions-text-page.name: TextPageComponent
regions-text-page.description:
The article of a long text page, such as a policy or a guide, drawn on the `
` it is placed on. Whoever places it projects a `
` with the title of the page as its `

` and the date it was last updated as a `

`, then the prose as plain headings, paragraphs, and lists. It may also project a `nav[dma-on-this-page]` with links to the sections of the prose, and a `section[dma-summary]` that opens the page with a short version of it. The article draws the header first, then the nav, the summary, and the prose, whatever the order of the content. The article fills its container up to the measure. From the desktop breakpoint up, the nav moves to a column of its own beside the rest, where it sticks while the article scrolls, and the article grows by that column. Its type sizes follow the Viewport tokens, so it needs no input for the viewport. The styles reach the projected elements, which emulated encapsulation leaves out, so the component turns encapsulation off and scopes every rule to its own selector instead.
